$:set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='.devcontainer/devcontainer.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
d['postAttachCommand']='gh codespace ports visibility 3000:private -c "$CODESPACE_NAME"'
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
f=.devcontainer/devcontainer.json
sha=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
gh api -X PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" -f message="Restrict terminal MCP port to private Codespace forwarding" -f sha="$sha" -f content="$(base64 -w0 "$f")" --jq '.commit.sha'
cd workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp
npm install --no-audit --no-fund
node --check http-server.mjs
node --check server.mjs
(PORT=39771 node http-server.mjs >/tmp/terminal-mcp-test.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/terminal-mcp-test.pid)
sleep 2
curl -sS -i --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:39771/mcp | head -12
kill "$(cat /tmp/terminal-mcp-test.pid)" || true
cat /tmp/terminal-mcp-test.log
